impact.slide1Content: A Brand built on creating tangible hope. With 100% of profits donated, Perfect World exists to help, not to exploit.
impact.slide2Content: We want to make a statement—a statement that combines style with a call for urgent change on our planet. Perfect World is about more than clothing; it's a movement that uses fashion to advocate for a better, more compassionate world. With each purchase, we invite our customers to make that same statement, to wear their values proudly, and to join us in raising awareness for causes that matter. We are glad you are here, reading this :) let's make a difference, together.
impact.slide3Content: We believe in the power fashion holds to make a Statement. Giving you a voice, while simultaneously aiding and supporting charities on the forefront of our global challenges.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do you produce your clothing?
faq.a1: At Perfect World, our clothing is made by Stanley/Stella — a producer committed to environmentally friendly practices and fair, ethical manufacturing. Every piece is printed on demand, made fresh only once you order, so nothing is overproduced and nothing goes to waste. It's apparel made with respect for both the planet and the people who make it.
faq.q2: How do I find my size?
faq.a2: Every product page has its own size chart — it's worth a quick look before you order, since each piece is made to order and we can't offer exchanges (more on that below). The easiest trick: take a t-shirt or hoodie you already own and love the fit of, lay it flat, and compare its measurements to the chart. One heads-up on our oversized styles — they're designed to sit loose and roomy, so if you prefer a closer fit, consider sizing down.
faq.a3: Because we print on demand, we're able to ship worldwide — wherever you are, we can get a piece to you.
faq.a4: Since each piece is made to order, delivery takes a little longer than an off-the-shelf shop. Production runs 0–3 days and shipping is roughly 6–8 days, so as a rough estimate, expect your order around 14 days from order to doorstep — a little more or less depending on your location. It's the honest trade-off of making clothing without waste, and we're actively working on ways to make it faster.
faq.a5: Because your order goes into production almost immediately, the window to cancel is very short. If you need to, email us at support@perfectworld.global as quickly as possible — if it hasn't gone to print yet, we'll do our best to stop it. Once a piece is in production, we're no longer able to cancel, since it's already being made just for you.
faq.q6: Do you accept refunds or exchanges?
faq.a6: Because every piece is made to order and 100% of profits are already donated, we're not able to offer refunds or exchanges — there's no stock to swap, and no margin to refund from. That's why we'd really encourage checking the size chart before you buy. The one exception: if your item arrives faulty or damaged, email us at support@perfectworld.global and we'll make it right. Thank you for understanding — it's what lets us give everything to the cause.
faq.q7: How can I get in touch with you?
faq.a7: For any questions, feedback, or help with an order, email us at support@perfectworld.global — we'd love to hear from you. :)
faq.q8: How do I know where my money goes, or if it's really donated?
faq.a8: Total transparency is the whole point. On our Transparency page you can see exactly how every euro is handled — production, fees, and donations. No one behind Perfect World takes a salary or a cut; everyone works pro bono, so that after production, 100% of the profit goes straight to the causes we support. We never want you to just take our word for it.

rich.title: Rich in Life
rich.heroLine1: Rich isn't a number in your bank account.
rich.heroLine2: The new collection — created with Mission Positivity.
rich.heroBadges: 100% of profits donated · Organic Stanley Stella · Produced in Germany
rich.introTitle: One shirt can't change the world. But here's what it can do.
rich.introBody: Every piece in this collection funds education for children in the rural Colombian villages of Paya, Milagros and La Unión — together with our partners at Mission Positivity. Not a percentage. Not "a portion of proceeds." 100% of profits, always.
rich.introPunch: You wear it. A kid goes to school. That's the whole business model.
rich.noProducts: No products found in the collection.

rich.madeTitle: Made when it's wanted. Not before.
rich.madeBody: We produce in batches to avoid overproduction and waste — no warehouses full of unsold stock. Your piece is printed here in Germany and ships within 7–10 days of your order.
rich.moneyBody1: Every order from this collection supports school materials, teaching and educational programs for children in rural Colombia.
rich.moneyBody2: Rich in Life is what it sounds like: the idea that being rich has nothing to do with what you own — and everything to do with what you give.
